definitions.title: How are these metrics calculated?
definitions.session: Service session: starts at the customer's first message when no session is open (after 24 h of silence since the last reply, or after the conversation was resolved). An unanswered session stays open until someone replies.
definitions.firstResponse: First response: time from the session start to the first reply from a person or the AI. First human response only counts replies from people. Internal notes and system messages don't count. P90: 90% of sessions were answered within that time.
definitions.sla: Response target: {minutes} minutes. Answered sessions count, plus sessions still unanswered past the target.
definitions.resolution: Resolution: from the session start until it was resolved. Source used:
definitions.unanswered: Waiting for a reply: conversations not closed whose last message (excluding internal notes) is from the customer.
